sections.what_happened: Three Ansar Allah ballistic missiles struck the al-Alam camp (Martyr Ahmed Al Sulaymani Training Centre) in Shabwa's Jardan district, hitting new security/police recruits during morning training. Toll: early 18-20 (Reuters/AP) -> 30+ (AFP/military sources) -> 50 killed, 100+ wounded (AFP citing deputy governor, 17:09 ) -> 53 killed, 200+ wounded (Haaretz citing local authorities). al-Alimi: Iran-backed attack, vows 'firm response.' Military source: fear of Mocha-style ground offensive; Ansar Allah cut Shabwa-Al-Bayda road. Context: 2022 truce collapsed earlier this year; government campaign near Bab al-Mandab.
sections.what_verified: Reuters, AP, AFP, Haaretz, The National, Anadolu, Economic Times — all agree on location, weapon (3 ballistic missiles), target (new recruits). SABA corroborates an attack occurred.
sections.what_disputed: Ansar Allah-run SABA gives no details. Ansar Allah Health Ministry counter-claims a Saudi-led airstrike killed 9 (5 children, 2 women) in Saada on Sunday — UNVERIFIED single source. No immediate Saudi comment.
sections.why_matters: Iran's ally just struck Saudi's ally with three ballistic missiles and killed 50 recruits. Yemen is the front nobody is watching — map: Shabwa, the cut Al-Bayda road, Mocha and Bab al-Mandab. Egypt's parliament vote on defending Saudi (postponed to Oct 26) is now the clock to watch.
sections.context: Background: Ansar Allah ballistic-missile strike on Yemeni government training camp in Shabwa — 50-53 killed (MISSED BY 1700 SCAN; toll update in-window)

totw_analysis: Our read: Iran's ally just struck Saudi's ally with three ballistic missiles and killed 50 recruits. Yemen is the front nobody is watching — map: Shabwa, the cut Al-Bayda road, Mocha and Bab al-Mandab. Egypt's parliament vote on defending Saudi (postponed to Oct 26) is now the clock to watch. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Will Saudi Arabia and Egypt answer Shabwa's plea for air defence — or is this the trigger for Egypt entering the Yemen war?
